origin.brief: The clock is buried deep; every tile on it costs a move and a tray spot.

builderCard.sentence: The clock is buried deep; every tile on it costs a move and a tray spot.
bites: The clock needs 19 moves and gets 20: 1 to spare.
2 tiles you must take on the way wait in the tray until after the clock: whatever the order, the tray reaches 3.
On the way the tray fills to 3, 2 moves with 3 waiting.
1 dig uncover a face-down tile while 2 wait (luck).
The twins of the tiles on the way are buried until after the clock.
